# Pull request

## Problem and scope

Describe the operator problem, affected workflow, and what remains out of scope.

## Behavior and evidence

Describe observable changes. For accessibility rules, identify the narrow evidence gathered and why the wording does not imply conformance.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] Network, redirect, parser, browser, path, and output risks were considered where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private targets, customer content, or live-scan data are included.
- [ ] Generated reports still communicate that automation is not a conformance determination.

## Validation

- [ ] Offline diagnostics pass.
- [ ] Core and adoption-asset regression tests pass.
- [ ] Browser regression passes when browser behavior changed.
- [ ] Ruff, Bandit, dependency audit, CodeQL, and secret scan pass as applicable.
- [ ] Package artifacts and isolated installs pass when packaging changed.
- [ ] Public Markdown contains no Unicode em dash characters.

List exact commands, versions, operating systems, and any manual evaluation performed.
